positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Fort Bragg, NC, United States · Hybrid
positions.description:
Develop new product features and new applications within an Agile environment as well as maintaining and supporting existing applications.   Diverse duties include collect business requirement and convert requirement to design/development/support, develop functional enhancements, upgrades to the system, work closely with the development teams and various business users to test new software programs/applications, troubleshot and resolve issues, develop documentation, translate business needs into written requirements.•	Help on the legacy migration of multiples project by using technology such as docker, GitLab, AWS, Azure, Kubernetes and Rancher.  
•	Demonstrate a high level of competence in object-oriented analysis, design, and coding in a .NET Cow\re server-side environment, specifically utilizing the Microsoft MVC framework.  
Highlights:
• ASP.net Core, C#, MVC5, and jQuery UI. MSSQL database, Team foundation 2013 and Visual Studio 2010/2013/2015/2017/2019.
•Wrote various technical documents, including Technical Specifications and test plans for web development.
•Successfully deploy multiples application into production with current technology standard provided by the command.
Environment:   ASP.net Core, C#, MVC4, and jQuery UI. MSSQL database, Team foundation 2013, Telerik kendo framework

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description:
Serve as a team member to participate in the design and life cycle development of systems which includes the design and development of applications using Microsoft Net technologies, and object-oriented technologies such as the Model View Controller (MVC) framework.  Mentor and lead as a team member to develop new product features and new applications within an Agile environment as well as maintaining and supporting existing applications.   Diverse duties include collect business requirement and convert requirement to design/development/support, develop functional enhancements, upgrades to the system, work closely with the development teams and various business users to test new software programs/applications, troubleshot, and resolve issues, develop documentation, translate business needs into written requirements.
•Excelled in rapid application development and management of technological issues for assigned projects, earning the highest customer satisfaction rating for all software solutions delivered.
•Participate in the development, implementation, and full life-cycle support of Government Off-the-Shelf (GOTS) software supporting the organization mission.
•Participate in the development, implementation, and full life-cycle support of Government Off-the-Shelf (GOTS) software supporting the organization mission.
•Contributed software engineering expertise in the development of products through the software lifecycle, from requirements definition through successful deployment.
•Demonstrate a high level of competence in object-oriented analysis, design, and coding in a .NET server-side environment, specifically utilizing the Microsoft MVC framework. 
•WPF, ASP.net, C#, MVC4, and jQuery UI. MSSQL database, Team foundation 2013 and Visual Studio 2010/2013/2015/2017.
Environment:  WPF, ASP.net, Web Form, C#, MVC4, and jQuery UI. MSSQL database, Team foundation 2013 Angular JS

positions.title: Senior Application Developer
positions.description:
Serve as a team member to develop new product features and new applications within an Agile environment as well as maintaining and supporting existing applications.   Diverse duties include design/development/support, develop functional enhancements, upgrades to the system, work closely with the development teams and various business users to test new software programs/applications, troubleshot and resolve issues, develop documentation, translate business needs into written requirements.

positions.title: Asp.Net Application Developer
positions.description:
Tetra Window application that use for applicant information and that background information. Add new applicant and order their background information.  Working as part of a team, to maintain Tetra windows application WPF software applications using Work in an agile environment.  Create XML Integration application using web service on WCF technology to process applicant background and add applicant background information in windows application.  Assists with design, coding, benchmark testing, debugging and documentation of programs. Develop technical specifications and test plans for web development.
Highlights:
•	WPF, ASP.net, C#, MVC4, and JQuery UI. MSSQL database, Team foundation 2013 and Visual Studio 2010/2013.
•	Develop technical specifications and test plans for web development. .
•	Environment:  WPF, ASP.net, C#, MVC4, and JQuery UI. MSSQL database, Team foundation 2013 and Visual Studio 2010/2013

positions.title: Net Developer
positions.description:
Working as part of a team, develop and maintain Toolbox software applications.  Assists with design, coding, benchmark testing, debugging and documentation of programs.  Applications generally dealing with utility programs, job control language, macros, subroutines and other control modules.  
Highlights:
•	Develop technical specifications and test plans for web development.  
•	Develop application to keep inventory of contract employee equipment. Create schedule repair equipment and order new equipment for new contract employee.
•	Environment:  ASP.net, C#, MVC4, and JQuery UI. MSSQL database, Visual Studio 2012

positions.title: Application Developer
positions.locationName: Coast Guard Aviation Logistics Center (ALC), Elizabeth City, NC
positions.description:
Working as part of a team, develop and maintain enterprise software applications using Work in an agile environment.  Assists with design, coding, benchmark testing, debugging and documentation of programs.  Applications generally dealing with utility programs, job control language, macros, subroutines and other control modules.  
Highlights:
•	Develop technical specifications and test plans for Logistics, supply chain, finance, aircraft/vessel mission operations, training records management, aircraft/vessel maintenance, electronic publishing, and web development.  
•	Environment:  ASP.net, C#, MVC4, LINQ and JQuery UI. MSSQL database, IBM Rational Synergy for source control.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Analyzed and discussed business requirements with the client.  Created use cases and performed walkthroughs with the client.  Assisted in creation of the project plans. Designed and developed modules for OLR applications.  Created system specifications and design documents for OLR and Online Payment prototype modeling.  Performed re-factoring, optimization and fine tuning of performance sensitive modules.  Installed and provided consulting support for OLR and Online Payment System.  Designed and deployed rdl files, data model and data source views for management and admin department related Reports.
Highlights:
•	Childcare Online Registration Portal (OLR):  Integrated Childcare Online Registration Portal (OLR) in existing LMN-Tree Child care application using latest ASP.net 4.0.  Designed OLR System Database using MSSQL 2008.  Environment: C#, Dot.net 4.0, SQL server2008, Java, HTML, Java script, Visual Studio 2010/2012.
•	LMN-tree reporting services:  Created/Designed Reporting data Warehouse. ETL data from LMN-Tree database into reporting Data Warehouse.  Designed and developed Reporting services for LMN-Tree childcare system. Designed and deployed management reports data model using SQL Server Business Intelligence Development Studio.  Designed and deployed management reports .rdl files using report builder 3.0.  Developed Query for generating drill down reports in SSRS 2008 prepared AD HOC reports through report builders.  Environment: MS-Sql2008, SSIS, SSRS, SharePoint
•	Global Payment online Payment Solution:  Integrated Global Payment online Payment solution in existing childcare program.  Added module for processing Electronics check and credit card with swiped and keyed feature for Centre director and Parent portal.  Automated the batch processing and parsing reporting data daily from global payment site for 150 centers.  Environment: SQL server2008, Java, HTML, Java script, VBScript.
